title: Appearance
description: How your menu looks to guests. Changes show in the preview right away; guests see them after you save.
themes_hint: Start from a ready-made look, then adjust it.
contrast_light: This colour is hard to read on white. Guests will see a darker shade of it so the text stays readable.

editorial.name: A · Warm editorial
editorial.hint: Big photos first and serif headings, like a printed café menu.

grid.name: B · Fresh grid
grid.hint: Your name on the banner and two photo cards per row, like a food app.

bistro.name: C · Quiet bistro
bistro.hint: A calm list with small photos on the right. Quickest to scan.

minimal.name: D · Minimal
minimal.hint: Text only: names, short descriptions and prices. No dish photos. Fastest.

mesob.name: E · Mesob
mesob.hint: Warm colours, woven bands and round photos. Made for Ethiopian and Somali food.

lounge.name: F · Night Lounge
lounge.hint: Always dark, with a soft glow in your colour. For bars, lounges and late nights.

board.name: G · Street Board
board.hint: A clean chalkboard with price tags. For fast food, burgers and juice bars.

flags.show_order_list: Show "My order" list (guests note dishes to show the waiter)
flags.show_other_branches: Show "Other branches" at the bottom of the menu (only with more than one branch)

images_hint: The banner is the wide photo at the top of your menu. It is cropped to the shape your menu style uses.
saved: Appearance saved. Guests see it now.
preview_hint: Preview of your menu on a phone (not saved yet).
preview_desktop_hint: Your menu as a computer shows it, with the changes you haven't saved yet.
